rules.alternatives: Current national certification from a pharmacy technician program accredited by the National Commission for Certifying Agencies (NCCA) instead of the 6 hours.
rules.notes: Registration expires October 31 and is renewed annually. Proof of 6 CE hours completed within the last 24 months and not used for a prior registration must be submitted with the renewal.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Having completed, within the last twenty-four months, six hours of continuing education that have not been utilized as continuing education credit for a prior registration;
